verdict.rationale: Supabase publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 Management API spec for managing organizations, projects, branches, and configuration, and a probe confirmed it is live at supabase.com/openapi.json. Each project also gets auto-generated REST and GraphQL data APIs with type generation and a documented API-key model, and Advisors are reachable through the Management API too. Missing for 10: quoted detail on Management API authentication, endpoint coverage and rate limits, and independent hands-on reports of agents driving it.
